readiness_scope: Sandbox/local validation unless an entry cites public_evidence_ref. Production-live cloud deployment is tracked separately.
narrative_vs_proof: Blogs and narrative-context are narrative_context only — not proof.

threat_model_split.saas_origin_dispatch: Outbound URL fetch from control plane to customer-configured targets — SSRF and redirect abuse apply here.
threat_model_split.private_edge_delivery: Ingester → egress → private target — distinct trust boundary; does not substitute for SaaS dispatch SSRF controls.
